segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides comprehensive financial services to high-net-worth individuals, families, corporate executives and businesses through brokerage and advisory accounts.
segments.evidence: Dominari Securities provides a comprehensive array of financial services to high-net-worth individuals and families, corporate executives, and public and private businesses.

segments.name: Investment Banking
segments.description: Provides strategic advisory and capital markets services to emerging growth and middle market businesses across multiple sectors.
segments.evidence: Dominari Securities' investment banking division provides strategic advisory services and capital markets products to emerging growth and middle market businesses.

segments.name: Sales and Trading
products: Institutional Fixed Income Sales and Trading
segments.description: Offers broad range of sales and trading services to clients for equities, derivatives, fixed income and securities lending.
segments.evidence: Dominari Securities provides a broad range of sales and trading services to our clients.

segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Provides discretionary and non-discretionary fee-based investment management solutions to high-net-worth clients, institutions and corporations.
segments.evidence: Dominari Securities offers discretionary and non-discretionary fee-based programs to provide tailored investment management solutions and services to high-net-worth private clients, institutions and corporations and/or plans sponsored by them.

revenueModel.text: The company earns commissions and fees from brokerage transactions, advisory services, asset-based management fees, investment banking underwriting and placement fees, and trading commissions and spreads.
revenueModel.evidence: The primary sources of revenue in each of the Company's business lines are commissions and fees earned on advisory and underwriting transactions and customer accounts managed by its employees.

changes.text: In 2023, the company acquired Dominari Securities LLC, a broker-dealer and investment adviser formerly named Fieldpoint Private Securities LLC, through its subsidiary Dominari Financial.
changes.evidence: The newly acquired dually registered broker-dealer and investment adviser was renamed Dominari Securities LLC ("Dominari Securities") and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Dominari Financial.

changes.text: In 2022, the company formed Dominari Financial Inc. as a wholly owned subsidiary to shift operating focus from biotechnology to fintech and financial services.
changes.evidence: In June of 2022, the Company formed a wholly owned financial services subsidiary, Dominari Financial Inc. ("Dominari Financial"), with the intent of shifting the Company's primary operating focus away from biotechnology to the fintech and financial services industries.

changes.text: In 2025, the company entered into agreements establishing American Ventures LLC and related management entities, holding a ninety percent membership interest.
changes.evidence: On June 17, 2025, the Company entered into two Limited Liability Agreements with American Ventures Management LLC ("AV Manager") and American Ventures IM LLC ("AV Investment Manager"). The Company holds a ninety percent (90%) Membership Interest in each.
